content_sections.heading: About PJTAU Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil)
content_sections.text: The Engineering Division of Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University, located in Rajendranagar, Hyderabad, undertakes major ongoing college building construction works under PJTAU. To supervise these major ongoing college building construction works, the university engages civil engineering professionals on a purely contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application forms along with self-attested photocopies of Educational Qualifications, Proof of Age, Experience Certificates, and ID Proof must be submitted in a sealed envelope superscribed "Application for AEE (Civil) on Contract Basis" to the following postal address: The Executive Engineer, Engineering Division, Administrative Building, PJTAU, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad – 500030. content_sections.heading: PJTAU Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) Job Description
content_sections.text: Project Execution: Oversee construction, civil works, roads, and drainage systems at project sites. Site Inspections: Conduct day-to-day field surveys, monitor work progress, and perform material quality checks. Quality & Safety Control: Ensure contractors adhere to standard technical specifications, safety protocols, and conduct compressive strength checks for concreting works. Billing & Measurement Records: Verify contractor work bills, maintain Measurement Books (M-Books), Quality Control (QC) registers, and site logs. Progress Reporting: Submit daily/weekly work execution and progress reports to superior officers.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth (SSC / Matriculation Certificate) B.Tech (Civil Engineering) Degree Certificate (First Class) Consolidated Marks Memo / Semester Marks Sheets Experience Certificate(s) showing minimum 1 year on-site experience Community / Caste Certificate (if applicable) Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN / Passport) Recent Passport Size Photograph (Self-Attested and affixed on the application form)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting will be based on academic record and relevant field experience only in 1:5 ratio. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated for further written test and interview. Final selection will be based on performance in the interview.
